title: LinkLayer rekey API does not enforce authenticated rekey evidence
description: Security review: reset_fragment_sessions_for_rekey accepts raw old/new public keys and permanently retires/installs keys based only on a documented caller precondition. Require a link-owned authenticated replay-fresh rekey envelope/capability bound to local, old, and new identities inside the atomic transaction; reject forged/copied/replayed/wrong-link evidence and isolate any explicit admin override.
